title.narrative: Improved access to comprehensive health, nutrition, and WASH services for IDPs and host community members and extremely hard to reach populations in Bama, Magumeri and Monguno LGAs in Borno State

description.narrative: ltpgtltspangtThe project lt/spangtltspangtwill target IDPs and host communities across Monguno, Magumeri and Bama. Through mobile clinic and Comprehensive Women Center, IRC will provide essential ltbgthealthlt/bgt services in Stadium, GGSS, and Gana Ali IDP camps and, systems support to existing state-run MCH clinic in Monguno to strengthen the provision of primary and reproductive healthcare services. While in Magumeri, the same service will be provided in Sulemanti A and B via mobile clinic and support to Magumeri MCH. IRC will engage and trained health worker to be deployed at the mobile clinic in IDP camp and hard to reach communities health. Health services will focus on IMCI for children U5, SAM management, routine immunization services, prevention and treatment of communicable illness, treatment of NCDs, ANC, PNC, management of sexually transmitted illness, family planning, basic emergency obstetrics and neonatal and newborn care, clinical care of sexual assault survivors and post-abortion care. Health systems support will be provided at all supported health facilities through capacity building of healthcare workers, supportive supervision, and the provision of essential medicines. Referral pathway will be strengthened through the establishment of ambulance services, medical bills payments as per invoices from UMTH based on existing MOU with IRC, and feeding of admitted patients and their caregiver. Endemic diseases such as malaria, acute watery diarrhea (AWD)/cholera and measles will be monitored, and in situations of increased morbidities or declared outbreaks, services will be adapted to be responsive to outbreak needs. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtIRC’s ltbgtWASHlt/bgt sector will deliver minimum WASH package to children admitted in Stabilization Centers (SC) for treatment of SAM and improve access to WASH services at household and community level in Suleimanti A and B, Kajari within Magumeri. The project will enhance water supply to improve access to safe and sustainable water supply systems, ensuring reliable and equitable access to clean water by the rehabilitating water facilities, installing inline water chlorinator and training WASH committees for operation and maintenance of water facilities. IRC will improve sanitation facilities, particularly in vulnerable communities, schools and health centers through rehabilitation of gender-sensitive and accessible latrines, dislodging fecal matter and waste management. To improve hygiene practices and behaviors, IRC will train CHVs to conduct hygiene promotion campaigns targeting communities, schools, and healthcare facilities to raise awareness on proper handwashing, menstrual hygiene management (MHM), and other key hygiene practices. The project will distribute WASH NFIs, MHM kits and cholera/AWD kits to encourage personal hygiene and water storage as a preventive measure against waterborne diseases. ltbrgtlt/spangtltspangtThe lt/spangtltbgtNutritionlt/bgtltspangt Program will improve access to quality preventive and curative nutrition services through early detection, skilled MIYCN counselling and treatment of SAM and MAM in Bama and Magumeri. 1 SC at Bama general Hospital, and 3 OTPs in Bama skin clinic, and MCH in Kasugula and Ex-boarding in Shehuri, and 3 OTPs and 3 TSFP sites in Magumeri - Suleimanti A, Suleimanti B and Kajeri- will be supported. Community level activities will be strengthened, and MAMA MUAC mothers mobilized to screen more children to elevate the capacity to respond to the ever-increasing demand for services during the lean season. The program will be expanded with mobile clinics offering outreach services within accessible hard-to-reach communities. SAM cases with complications will be referred to the SC for inpatient care and treatment. MIYCN services will be provided across all sites and at community level. Nutrition best practices messages will be disseminated to all communities to enhance the utilization of the recommended locally available foodstuffs. The protection sector, safeguarding, and governance programs will be entrenched into IRC activities for integration.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtlt/pgt
